gating: end-expiration third of the steady non-SI spokes; polarity = histogram mode (a) and the SI shift between the two thirds in a liver-dome box and a heart box (b, polarity_boxes.json, valid at >= 1 voxel); (a) alone if (b) is undetermined and the dwell asymmetry is >= 2 (subject flagged gating=weak)
coil_maps: 112^3 (R0, polarity): echo 0, r0 spokes: bart nufft -i -x 112:112:112 -> bart fft -u 7 -> bart ecalib -t 0.001 -c 0.0 -r 24 -m 1; 224^3 (REF, subsets): central |k| < 56 samples on 112^3 over 448 mm, ecalib -r 48, Fourier-interpolated to 224^3, unit sum of squares
ref: bart pics -t <traj> -l2 -r <ref_lam_rel x lambda_max> -i 100 -S -d5; lambda_max = largest eigenvalue of this subject's REF operator (bart pics -e -d5), recon/<Vxx>/ref_lmax.json
ref_scaling: BART's own (-d5 'Inverse scaling of the data'), reused as -w by every subset of the same echo
l1_subsets: bart pics -t <traj> -l1 -r 0.003 -i 100 -e -S -w <ref scaling> (absolute lambda in BART's data scaling; early-stopped FISTA)
subsets: whole interleaves, target AF 8/12/16, AF = 19704 / spokes
